findings.title: Sevinçli haber, adıyla belirlenen ilahi görevlendirmeyi duyurur
findings.claim: 19:7'deki sevindirici haber, Yahya'nın yalnızca doğumunu değil, adıyla belirlenen ve önceki bir adaşın bulunmadığı ilahi bir görevlendirmeyi duyurur.
findings.mechanism: Focus'taki نُبَشِّرُكَ, ٱسْمُهُ ve سَمِيًّا yüzeyleri; sırasıyla bir oğul müjdesi, adla belirleme ve adaşlığın reddi ilişkilerini taşır. 15:53 ve 3:39'daki adlandırılmış oğul müjdeleri bu haber verme ve ad verme temasını genişletir; 19:65'teki سَمِيًّا sorusu son reddi aynı-surah ad/adaşlık temasına geri bağlar.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, müjdeyi yalnızca bir doğum bilgisinin iletilmesi olarak değil, adıyla tanınacak benzersiz bir kimliğin duyurulması olarak da fark eder.
findings.containment: Bu okuma, ayetin Zekeriya'ya Yahya adlı bir oğul müjdesi olarak açık anlamını korur. Genişleyen ilişki adlandırma ve adaşlıkla sınırlıdır; Yahya için ilahlık, mutlak eşitlik, üstünlük, rekabet veya karakter denkliği ileri sürülmez. Bağlantı ayetlerinin hedef morfolojisi pakette bulunmadığından küresel yankı bu sınırla niteliklidir.

epistemic.reason: Supplied focus branches and the cross-run finding are trusted and the three connection targets have exact Arabic, but the connection records do not supply target morphology or independent target lexical analysis; the resulting global resonance is therefore retained with explicit qualification.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sevindirici haber verme; kötü haberde açık nitelemeli alaycı bildirim
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye onu sevindirecek bir haber verilir.
branch_activations.carrier: نُبَشِّرُكَ carries the focus's Form II act of giving Zakariyya glad tidings.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 15:53 connection gives exact Arabic for a parallel reassurance and announcement of a son; its target morphology is not supplied.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated announcement-to-a-recipient pattern makes the focus's glad tidings part of a wider recurring form of divinely delivered son-announcement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's glad tidings is newly perceptible as a concrete divine announcement carrying the promised boy toward an identified vocation, rather than as generic information alone.
branch_activations.boundary: The parallel establishes an announcement relation, not a claim that the two boys have the same qualities or that the target morphology has been independently analyzed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ad, adlandırma ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik
branch_activations.facet_statement: Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱسْمُهُ carries the naming clause that identifies the announced boy.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 3:39 connection gives exact Arabic and an authored note for angels announcing Yahya by name to Zakariyya; its target morphology is not supplied.
branch_activations.activation: The named-child announcement in 3:39 contacts the focus's name clause and makes the assigned name part of the wider announcement pattern.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The name is newly perceptible as an integral act of the divine gift: the promised boy arrives already marked by a stated identity.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the naming relation only; it does not import the target ayah's additional qualities or claim that every associated name facet is active here.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ad, adlandırma ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik
branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
branch_activations.carrier: سَمِيًّا carries the denied namesake relation in the focus's final phrase.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 19:65 connection gives exact Arabic for the question هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا and identifies it as the same-surah namesake challenge; its target morphology is not supplied.
branch_activations.activation: The same-surface namesake question returns through سَمِيًّا and gives the focus's prior-namesake denial a wider same-surah identity boundary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Yahya's stated name becomes newly perceptible as an unprecedented designation within the supplied same-surah namesake field.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation concerns prior naming and namesake relation only; it does not assert equality with God, rank, rivalry, or character equivalence.
